# openmetadata_api_collection (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata API collection by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_api_collection" "pets" {
  fully_qualified_name = "payments-api.pets"
}

output "pets_api_collection_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_api_collection.pets.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) API collection fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) API collection UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `endpoint_url` (String) Root URL shared by the endpoints in this collection.
- `name` (String) API collection name.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent API service.
- `service_type` (String) OpenMetadata API service type.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
